thread:
Noah Kim: quick sync on p95 card + heatmap tweaks for the new dashboard patch
Rhea Singh: thanks! two quick asks: legend contrast and the preset list.
Diego Alvarez: legend: current pastel -> low contrast. suggest switching to a mono-sequential scale (teal) and add hatch patterns for top buckets.
Clara Wu: +1 for patterns. also, in compact mode the heatmap gets squashed; propose a 1-row summary with a hover-to-expand affordance.
Noah Kim: good. UX question: default sampling state? ops wants ON to avoid empty dashboards, but docs need to make "auto" explicit.
Rhea Singh: copy: use "Auto sampling (may aggregate)" as label and include a tooltip linking to docs.
Diego Alvarez: performance note: client-side full-resolution heatmap is heavy for >100 routes. we'll show a "Aggregated" badge when server returns histogram-aggregated data.
Clara Wu: accessibility: a11y-bot flagged legend contrast 3.4:1. Need >=4.5:1 for body copy. Also ensure expand button has visible focus styles.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: legend text color #0b1220 or font-weight 600; ensure expand button uses box-shadow focus ring and aria-expanded toggles properly.
Noah Kim: percentiles: keep p95 as default. add a tiny "percentile" menu to toggle p50/p99 overlays. In multi-line mode, compact legend should show small color swatches with labels.
Rhea Singh: small microcopy change: under heatmap use "Percentiles across requests — lighter = faster, darker = slower." clearer for new users.
Diego Alvarez: I'll add CSS prototype for patterns and send PR.
Clara Wu: I'll update figma and QA notes. Filing follow-up tickets: ENG-UI-1250 (legend a11y), ENG-UI-1251 (sampling copy + badge), ENG-UI-1252 (compact expand interaction).
Noah Kim: perfect—thanks all :thumbsup:
